name: Creation
about: The heavens declare the glory of God.

teachings.title: A literal creation about 6,000 years ago
teachings.summary: Genesis 1 is a literal account of creation about 6,200 years ago because God who cannot lie says so, and evolution is worship of time, a created thing.
teachings.text:
Now, note the order of things. This is how all of creation was made. And the creation of days, separated from night, morning and evening, was created by God who is outside of time.

The fullness of the Godhead exists when nothing else did, including time, and through Him was created light, substance, life, and mankind. Everything after its own kind, with the seed contained therein propagating that life over time.

This is a literal story of creation, as it occurred roughly 6,200 years ago.

Not because of fossils found in weird places, or the problems with carbon dating, or the position of the stars in the firmament unchanging, or the complexity and variance of life.

But because God said this is how it happened. In His inspired and preserved word, The God who cannot lie tells us these things and that they are so.

Evolution, which is the worship of time, or Kronos as the creator, is literally the worship of the created, as we see in Genesis, because God created time. And so we know it's false.

Biblical inerrancy, and the fundamentalist belief that it is the inspired and preserved word of God, has yet to fail, even as science falsely so-called makes claims to the contrary, God's hand is revealed continually making the wise into fools.

This is why God's word is continually under attack. This is why doubt is continually sown. Because, if many have doubts about any aspect of God's word, then many will not believe the report. The Gospel, and will perish as sinners.

And while you don't have to necessarily believe in the literal biblical creation in order to believe that Jesus is the son of God who died for our sins and was resurrected again, and whom through which we are given Grace by God unto eternal life, it is difficult to then express that Faith to others while doubting much of His word. Or thinking it allegory, or some sort of parable.

The gospels give account back to Adam. The genealogies are there to mark time. And the generations from Noah back to Adam, from Abraham back to Noah, from Israel to Christ... These are there for a purpose.

And while there are some seeking to take away from God's word by casting doubt not just on the creation story but on every biblical text that draws upon it, all scripture that refers to it in describing Jesus Christ to us, there are people that seek to add to his word as well. It is easy to read into it things that are not there, and this too is an error.

So as we go forth through Genesis understand that it is not only the faith of this author, but my firm opinion that the Bible is literally true, and the truths revealed from Genesis 1 through the end in Revelation 22, is the story of Jesus Christ. God revealing His Son to us that we may believe and have eternal life.

It is God's word, His testimony, the testaments that He has given us to His promise for us. And from start to finish, Alpha to Omega it is one gospel, the good news of salvation through Christ Jesus.

teachings.title: The chronogenealogies and a young earth
teachings.summary: The ages in Genesis 5 and 11 are given literally and, with the generations to Christ, place the earth at about 6,000 years old.
teachings.text:
For my autistic brothers in Christ, this is 1,558 years from Adam to Shem.

The chronogenealogies of Genesis 5 are given to provide times and understanding of the human nature of man, and to provide the direct lineage from Adam to Noah and his sons.

Long-lived though they may have been, they lived, had children and died*. They populated the earth. They all sinned whether sons of God or sons of man, whether they called upon the name of the Lord or rejected His salvation.

But they lived and these were the span of years from creation to Noah and his sons.

Biblical authority and fundamentalism should rest on rightly dividing the word of God, and taking what's given literally as literal, and what's parable, a picture or a symbol as figurative. These ages are given literally.

It is odd how those who take the figurative literally, such as the Nicodemuses who gets caught up in misunderstood false doctrine taken from parables, almost invariably take the literal as symbolic, and most reject the specific accounting of years from creation to flood, to Christ.

And so, taking the Bible literal where it's given to us literally, and going from **Genesis 5** to **Genesis 11:32**, we get to Shem's descendant Terah, father of Abraham. Adding all of the provided years gives us a time span of about 2,008 years from Adam to Abraham.

And from **Matthew 1**, we are given the generations from Abraham to Jesus Christ.

*So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ are fourteen generations.*

The total of these generations isn't as precise but adds up to roughly 2,000 years to the first coming of the Messiah.

As far as the Bible goes, we have recorded the rough years from creation to Christ, given, inspired and preserved by God. The time from Christ to now, the anno domini so to speak, well, that could be roughly 2022 years. It may not be. Missing time, garbled calendars, i's for 1's...I can't say. The calendar is not the preserved word of God. (I lean towards some centuries being faked and it being less time from Christ to now, but it's all speculation)

But taking the given ~2020 years that is commonly accepted, this places the earth at just slightly more than 6,000 years old. Give or take a century or two.

I have never seen anything convincing that suggests otherwise, through all the science so-called, and theories and theologies of man. In fact, given time, the wisdom of man invariably fails and is changed to fit new secular theories, unfalsifiable as they are.

But God's word is the rock of our salvation, that we as believers build our faith and our lives upon. Unchanged and unchangeable.

teachings.title: The heavens declare the glory of God
teachings.summary: Creation and conscience reveal God's power and law to all men so that they are without excuse, while His written word gives the hope of mercy and leads to salvation.
teachings.text:
**Psalm 19** is fairly short, yet packed with doctrine, teaching the purpose of creation, the testimony of God to all creatures, the picture of Christ, and the establishment of the law of the Lord in nature itself, that there is no excuse, while the believer is given constant reminders of His judgements.

**Romans 1:18–20**
*For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness; Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them. For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse*

The heavens declare the glory of God. Looking upon the night sky we see His precision and power. And as the day follows day and night follows night, each with the passing of the sun and the stars, we are given evidence of His might.

The things of creation speak without words, that all man may understand. They don't need a language. They don't need to be explained. Man sees the passage of time, seasons, years, decades even, in heavenly bodies.

The vain hypothetical of a savage on a remote island, never hearing the gospel, is undone by the understanding that all nature is a parable and a testament of God, showing men truth.

The boldness of the sun breaking forth in the morning is as the risen Christ, returning in glory, a picture of the Creator Who is blessed forever, amen.

Nature teaches us God's law. His ways.

**1 Corinthians 11:14**
*Doth not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?*

His wrath is revealed against those who sin, even without the oracles of God documenting His commandments. The Spirit showing mankind the results of their transgressions. The understanding that murder, adultery, lying, stealing, all of these things that do harm to your neighbor and are a shame before God, are known.

**Romans 2:11–16**
*For there is no respect of persons with God. For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law; (For not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified. For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;) In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.*

Man can see the law of God, know it written in their hearts, watch the outcome of their behavior and the wrath upon those who sin, and know they are guilty before the consuming fire which is God.

How much more are we who have His statutes and commandments by the oracles of God?

**Romans 3:1–2**
*What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit is there of circumcision? Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.*

The advantage given Israel, and held by the Jews in Paul's day, is now given to the world. That everyone may know His word.

*The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.*

If the day declares His righteousness and the night His knowledge, and the very nature of things speaks to His wrath, then the oracles of God give us the hope of His mercy. God is a rewarder to those that diligently seek Him.

The fear of the Lord is clean, and known to all men. The fool may say in their heart there is no God, but the wise fear Him, even if they don't know scripture.

The truth is more desirable than gold, sweeter than honey. Its pursuit is its own reward, spurring us to seek Him. The warnings and rewards, motivation to learn His ways.

And, in that knowledge, we find His word, and from that word, salvation.

teachings.title: Evolution versus the testimony of creation
teachings.summary: Evolution is unfalsifiable science falsely so-called, while biblical creation, God's testimony, explains the kinds, complexity and origin of nations.
teachings.text:
The disproved theory of Evolution of the species, which has become unfalsifiable nonsense requiring increasingly foolish leaps, requiring the constant changing of factors like time frame, scale, etc as each presents a problem. Rather than abandoning the theory, adherents simply say the natural observations and assumptions that disprove it must be wrong. Including the math of time and adaptation that definitively debunks it.

Meanwhile, Biblical creation is proved as the testimony of God, and explains the kinds and types, impossible adaptations, incredible beauty, complexity of systems and gives us a true accounting of the origin of race and nations, and the boundaries and habitations thereof.

Nonbelievers have faith in science, falsely so-called and the theories of Jews and Masons and Jesuits that tickle their ears and appeal to their conceits, so much so that the shifting narratives used to buttress it fail to even elicit a blip of cognitive dissonance.

teachings.title: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest
teachings.summary: God vowed after the flood to preserve the seasons until the end, so environmental and climate panic is unbiblical.
teachings.text:
Noah settled in, ark unloaded makes sacrifice to God, (an act of incredible faith given the limited number of animals to survive the flood), and it is pleasing unto God.

*And the Lord smelled a sweet savour; and the Lord said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake; for the imagination of man's heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done. While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.*

God gives us insight to His thought process, recognizing the evil imagination within man's heart, and vows never to destroy every living thing because of it. Rather than curse the ground and total destruction of life, God vows to preserve the world as is until the end.

This is why environmentalist panic is unbiblical nonsense. We are not going to see cataclysmic climate change of any type before the day of the Lord.

I wonder sometimes that the entire point of climate panic is to make those alive during the tribulation and into the wrath of God doubt His hand in it. I think it's foolish cope, but there probably will be some deluded souls, even as the locusts of Hell bite them in the darkness, blaming heckin' CO2 emissions.

We will see the covenant with Noah God gives in Genesis 9.

teachings.title: Evolution undermines the case for nations
teachings.summary: Evolution's change-or-die logic justifies race mixing and erasing borders, whereas nations exist and are blessed or destroyed by God's handiwork and judgment.
teachings.text:
Rather than provide a basis and rationalizations for race and ethnicity, and justification for segregation and nations, the theory of evolution actually undermines all of it with its central tenant of 'change or die.'

If evolution is real, and all creatures when exposed to other forces must change over time, seeking genetic dominance and continuation, then how is it not only natural but advantageous for the mixing of races, the dominance of the sub-Saharan population as it spreads across Europe, for example. Or the American erasure of Anglo-Germanic stock, replaced by brown goblins?

How can one make an argument for national purity for what is currently an endangered species in the face of overwhelming pressures to adapt and change? To cross breed for advantage? To erase borders as outdated constructs, giving way instead to migratory patterns of a global natural selection?

It is with the God of the Bible and His handiwork that we have nations of men. It is His judgement that blesses and destroys bloodlines, ethnicities, nations.

It may feel easier to blame it all on the vagaries of chance, the fickle forces of evolution changing man over time, and place hope on some sort of eugenic natural preservation system, like we have for elephants or panda bears, to keep Whites as a race, alive. Easier than turning to God and allowing Him to heal your nation and keep it and bless it. But in the long run you simply shoot your own cause in the foot.

teachings.title: The wrath of God revealed from heaven
teachings.summary: God reveals His wrath through creation and conscience so all are without excuse, and those who hold the truth in unrighteousness and worship the creature have their hearts darkened.
teachings.text:
So, in our prior instalment we see the righteousness of God is revealed to man through those that are saved sharing the Gospel of God in Christ Jesus with others. Here we see that God also reveals His nature, His wrath, from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men.

Their literal unrighteousness is part of His wrath. Man is punished by their own sin. We see it all the time, that the consequences of sin is a curse, teaching the wages of sin is death. Nature has revealed to us this truth, the system of consequence. We see it in the downfall of our own current society. We see the effects of sin in our own lives.

Because that which may be known of God is manifest in those who hold the truth in unrighteousness. God has shown men His judgment.

Man has a conscience. The law of God is written in our hearts. The Spirit has come to convict men of sin that they may know they need salvation. The law worked in the OT times to do the same, as a schoolmaster to our unrighteousness that we may seek salvation in the Lord.

These invisible things of God are visible, clearly seen, from the creation of the world through now. And His wrath is understood by His creation. Man understands right from wrong, as Paul gets into later in Romans.

We see His power and destruction in nature. We see it in the flood. In Sodom and Gomorrah. The judgment of nations.

We see the eternal power of the Godhead and so, all men are without excuse.

But men that knew God through His revelation, weren't thankful to God and didn't glorify Him as God, but became vain in their imaginations. Men knowing the judgment and wrath of God made up stories to explain it. Devised often complex systems of works and worship of idols to justify their sin. Vain, meaning unprofitable and a waste of time. Even today they invent a false god out of the Biblical God, and their perverse version of Jesus, while ignoring the truth of His judgment.

These people, the Bible says, have their foolish hearts darkened. Hardened. They become worse with time, clinging to their vain beliefs and not recognizing the truth of God through His revelations to us.

Prophets. His word. His power. The Gospel. His wrath. These things are given that all men seeking truth shall find it.

But those who became vain in their imaginations, whose foolish hearts are darkened, who profess themselves wise become fools, and change the glory of an uncorruptible God into idols, images made like unto corruptible man, like the Catholic church or the Orthodox that split off it. Or like unto birds, and animals and creeping things. Worship of nature. Worship of themselves even.

Worship of the created more than the Creator.

Because of all that...well, Paul tells us what ends up happening to these people in the following verses.

teachings.title: Scofield's gap theory from Jeremiah 4
teachings.summary: Scofield invented the gap theory between Genesis 1:1 and 1:2 from Jeremiah 4, so if he added to the first verse, none of his notes should be trusted.
teachings.text:
Scofield used his notes, interrupting the text of Scripture itself, column notes and foot notes, to add commentary and invent doctrine out of thin air.

Even today, a century later, this toxic corruption has infiltrated a majority of evangelical and many Baptist churches. Just as Judaizers had already taken root in Protestant sects and their seminaries, Scofield was the foot in the door to Bible colleges and KJVO churches.

But the heresies of C. I. Scofield were evident in the first chapter of the first book in the opening verses of the Bible.

In Genesis 1, he interrupts God's creation, to invent the idea that between verse 1;  *In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.*

And verse 2 *And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.*

That there was a span of an earlier creation, that millions or billions of years passed. That there was a "gap," between the initial creation, and the ultimate creation, and that this was proved by the vision of Jeremiah in chapter 4:23-26.

He claims that this passage "clearly indicates" that the earth had undergone a "cataclysmic change as a result of divine judgement." That we could see evidence of this pre-Eden, pre-Adamic destruction. That Jeremiah was seeing a vision of this past event. That this would match the geologists of the era, and their theories of the earth being billions of years old. That the earth wasn't made fully formed and stocked with life, but that God had made it before as habitations for angels, who fell, and was destroyed and left void and without form until he renewed creation for Eden.

The Gap theory was very popular for a time in American Evangelical circles, but is almost universally rejected today by believing Christians, despite their continued use of the Scofield, and acceptance of other heresy he taught.

But if he is inventing things in the first verse of the first chapter. Why do they trust anything else he wrote?
